from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.github/qa/contact-motion-check.txt')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);'
new = '''assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0, JSON.stringify(await page.locator(pending).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => ({ className: el.className, bounds: el.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(), viewport: [innerWidth, innerHeight], scrollY })))));'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
old_finish = '''  await page.waitForTimeout(750);
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));'''
new_finish = '''  // A stepped jump can miss a target's 15% interval. Explicitly visit any
  // remaining item before comparing the fully-revealed layout. Do not force
  // reveal attributes or disable motion; the real observer/fallback must run.
  // Exact-threshold and rapid-scroll behavior have separate checks below.
  for (const element of await page.locator(pending).elementHandles()) {
    await element.evaluate((el) => el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'instant' }));
    await page.waitForFunction((el) => el.dataset.contactRevealState !== 'pending', element);
    await element.dispose();
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(750);
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));'''
assert s.count(old_finish) == 1
s = s.replace(old_finish, new_finish)
marker = '  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {'
extra = '''  await check(browser, engine, 'missed-observer-notification-fallback', async (page) => {
    await page.addInitScript(() => {
      window.IntersectionObserver = class {
        observe() {}
        unobserve() {}
        disconnect() {}
      };
    });
    await mount(page);
    const figure = page.locator('.contact-map__figure');
    await figure.evaluate((el) => {
      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      window.scrollTo({ top: scrollY + box.top - innerHeight + box.height * 0.1, behavior: 'instant' });
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(180);
    assert.equal(await figure.getAttribute('data-contact-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await figure.evaluate((el) => {
      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      window.scrollTo({ top: scrollY + box.top - innerHeight + box.height * 0.35, behavior: 'instant' });
    });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.contact-map__figure').dataset.contactRevealState === 'visible');
    await page.waitForTimeout(600);
    assert.equal(await figure.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    await assertFormStatic(page);
  });

'''
assert s.count(marker) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(marker, extra + marker))
